description: Shield tilted diagonally 45 degrees from the left forearm, with its tip pointing down and outward and the fist behind the wood. Short leather grip and continuous leather straps attach to the actual rear panel surface.

mount.panel_long_axis: 45 degrees from elbow-to-wrist axis; tip down and outward
mount.strap_attachment: Continuous leather ribbons anchored into the rear wood; no projecting metal brackets.
